advancement.scc.autocraft.description: You asked the network for something it did not have, and it went and built the thing.
advancement.scc.autocraft.title: Order Up
advancement.scc.big_job.description: A single order ran through ten steps or more and finished without you touching anything.
advancement.scc.big_job.title: Ten Steps Ahead
advancement.scc.big_network.description: A hundred blocks on one network, and it still answers the moment you open a terminal.
advancement.scc.big_network.title: Cable Empire
advancement.scc.bridge.description: A transmitter and a receiver carry your network across the gap - or across a whole dimension.
advancement.scc.bridge.title: Long Distance
advancement.scc.controller.description: You placed a Calculator Controller: give it power and everything you attach to it becomes a single network.
advancement.scc.controller.title: Brain in a Box
advancement.scc.cradle.description: Ignite a star in the Stellar Cradle.
advancement.scc.cradle.title: Let There Be Light
advancement.scc.crafter.description: A Calculation Crafter is standing by, ready to follow a recipe so that you do not have to.
advancement.scc.crafter.title: Hired Help
advancement.scc.distributor.description: A Stellar Distributor powers the machines around it without a single cable.
advancement.scc.distributor.title: Look, No Cables
advancement.scc.multistep.description: The network worked out a recipe made of recipes and ran every step of it in the right order.
advancement.scc.multistep.title: Chain Reaction
advancement.scc.photons.description: A Sky Harvester in photon mode fed its first starlight into your network - power without any other mod.
advancement.scc.photons.title: Starlight Power
advancement.scc.processing.description: A Processing Calculator is watching a machine, so the network can smelt and press without your hands in it.
advancement.scc.processing.title: Remote Control
advancement.scc.pulsar.description: A Blue Giant went supernova in your Stellar Cradle, the barrier held, and a Pulsar remains.
advancement.scc.pulsar.title: Contained
advancement.scc.root.description: One network that holds everything you own and builds anything you ask it for - the manual knows the rest.
advancement.scc.root.title: Super Cool Calculator
advancement.scc.singularity.title: Event Horizon
advancement.scc.singularity_storage.desc: A Singularity storage block: the last time you will ever think about running out of space.
advancement.scc.sky_harvester.descriptio: Your Sky Harvester pulled its first piece of matter out of the sky.
advancement.scc.sky_harvester.title: Reach for the Stars
advancement.scc.standing_order.descripti: A standing order placed a job all by itself - the network now works while you are away.
advancement.scc.standing_order.title: Set and Forget
advancement.scc.star_forge.description: Forge something in the Star Forge.
advancement.scc.star_forge.title: Stellar Nucleosynthesis
advancement.scc.storage_block.descriptio: A storage block of your own - from here on the network no longer needs a chest behind every connector.
advancement.scc.storage_block.title: Shelf Life
advancement.scc.stored.description: You put something into the network instead of into a chest, and you can still find it in one search.
advancement.scc.stored.title: Out of Sight
advancement.scc.supernova.description: Watch a Blue Giant go supernova - in the Star Forge or in the Stellar Cradle.
advancement.scc.supernova.title: Supernova
advancement.scc.terminal.description: Your network is running, and one terminal now shows you the contents of every container on it.
advancement.scc.terminal.title: Every Chest at Once
advancement.scc.upgrade.description: You lifted a block a whole tier without losing a single filter, side or setting.
advancement.scc.upgrade.title: Moving Up
advancement.scc.wireless.description: Your wireless terminal knows its antenna, so the whole network now fits in a pocket.
advancement.scc.wireless.title: No Strings Attached
advancement.scc.wormhole.description: Step into a Wormhole Gate and come out on top of another one.
advancement.scc.wormhole.title: Shortcut Through Spacetime
item.scc.upgrade_blue_giant_to_neutron_s: Tier Upgrade (Blue Giant to Neutron Star)
item.scc.upgrade_red_dwarf_to_yellow_sta: Tier Upgrade (Red Dwarf to Yellow Star)
item.scc.upgrade_yellow_star_to_blue_gia: Tier Upgrade (Yellow Star to Blue Giant)
key.scc.job_details: Details of the last finished order
key.scc.pocket: Stellar Pocket (tap: put away, hold: pick)
scc.analysis.explain: Walk through every recipe once - with JEI or EMI that includes all machine categories such as Inscriber or Enrichment Chamber. The result is saved and applies to the whole modpack, on every server and in every world.
scc.analysis.state.running: Analysis running - you can keep playing
scc.analysis.tip.clear: Deletes the saved result so everything is recomputed.
scc.analysis.tip.start: Walks through all recipes once. Takes a few seconds depending on the pack - the game keeps running.
scc.analysis.title: Recipe analysis
scc.asleep.chat.head: [SCC] %s area(s) of your network are not loaded:
scc.asleep.click: Click: mark them in the world for 60 seconds and list them in chat.
scc.asleep.hint: These chunks are not loaded, so the machines and storage there are missing from the network. Go there or keep them loaded with a chunk loader - SCC never loads chunks by itself.
scc.brush.gui.design: A painted block looks like this for every player, whatever they picked under F7.
scc.brush.gui.hint: Click a design, then right-click blocks with the brush. Shift + right-click a block copies its design.
scc.brush.gui.standard: Standard resets a block: it shows whatever design each player picked under F7.
scc.brush.notLoaded: Design shows after the next resource reload (F3+T) - or turn on Preload all designs (F7).
scc.brush.tip.choose: Right-click the air to choose a design
scc.brush.tip.gear: Stellar Gear in the off hand: right-click the air to paint it (sneak: choose).
scc.brush.tip.paint: Right-click an SCC block to paint it
scc.brush.tip.pick: Shift + right-click a block to copy its design
scc.bubble.broken: This mob can't be released here
scc.bubble.release: Right-click a block to release it
scc.cmd.needplayer: This command has to be run by a player.
scc.cmd.nonetwork: No SCC block nearby - stand next to your network.
scc.cmd.order.noplanner: This network has no terminal to plan the order with.
scc.cmd.order.norecipe: The network knows no way to craft %s.
scc.cmd.order.noterminal: You need a linked Wireless Terminal in your inventory or Curios slot to order by command.
scc.cmd.order.offline: The network is offline - nothing can be ordered right now.
scc.cmd.profile.off: The profiler is not running. Turn it on with /scc profile on, play for a few minutes, then run /scc profile.
scc.cmd.profile.on: Profiler running. Keep playing normally for a few minutes, then run /scc profile.
scc.cmd.reloadconfig: SCC server settings reloaded from config/scc-server.json and sent to all players.
scc.cmd.selftest: Self-test finished: %s checks, %s failures. Details are in scc.log.
scc.cmd.unstick: %s machines cleared - whatever is left inside goes back to storage.
scc.constellation.btn.fit.tip: Shows the whole network again, seen at an angle from above.
scc.constellation.btn.full.tip: Opens the network as a star map in a big window.
scc.constellation.btn.top.tip: Straight from above, north up - like a map.
scc.constellation.click.mark: Click: highlight it in the world
scc.constellation.click.open: Click: open its window - Shift-click: highlight
scc.constellation.help: Drag: move - Wheel: zoom - Right-drag: turn
scc.constellation.title: Constellation View
scc.constellation.truncated: Big network: %s stars shown of %s blocks
scc.diag.asleep.fix: Keep that area loaded with a chunk loader, or stand in it while you use those machines.
scc.diag.asleep.head: Part of the network is not loaded (%s area(s))
scc.diag.asleep.why: Not loaded right now: %s. Machines and storage there are missing from autocrafting, upgrades and the item list until those chunks are loaded again - SCC never loads chunks by itself.
scc.diag.blind.fix: Open the calculator and pick the machine in front of it, or move it so it faces one.
scc.diag.blind.head: %s calculators have no machine set
scc.diag.blind.why: A Processing Calculator only works once it knows which machine it belongs to. Until then it is on the network but does nothing.
scc.diag.clean.head: Nothing wrong with this network
scc.diag.clean.why: It is online, it has storage, and every calculator knows a machine it can reach.
scc.diag.full.fix: Add another storage block, or raise the tier of the ones you have. A Storage Connector with 'void excess' on can absorb the rest.
scc.diag.full.head: Storage is nearly full
scc.diag.full.why: %s of %s slots are in use. An order that cannot put its result away stops and waits.
scc.diag.handonly.fix: Use the mod's own automated version instead - for the Engineer's Workbench that is the Automated Engineer's Workbench.
scc.diag.handonly.why: This block only works by hand: it offers no inventory on any side, and its results only appear in its own window (e.g. the Engineer's Workbench from Immersive Engineering).
scc.diag.job.empty.fix: The recipe resolves to an empty result. That is a fault in the recipe itself - please report which item it was.
scc.diag.job.empty.head: Stopped: this recipe produces nothing
scc.diag.job.flowwait.fix: Its flow waits for the next wave, the cycle time or enough energy - this is set under Flow & targets and goes on by itself.
scc.diag.job.flowwait.head: Waiting: the recipe flow is not ready yet
scc.diag.job.locked.fix: Nothing to do unless it stays like this. If it does, the machine is jammed or has no power.
scc.diag.job.locked.head: Waiting: the machine is still running
scc.diag.job.machinefull.fix: Its output slots are not being emptied. A Transfer Calculator or a second Processing Calculator on the output side clears them.
scc.diag.job.machinefull.head: Waiting: the machine is full
scc.diag.job.missing.fix: Put the missing item into the network, or make sure a recipe for it exists and its machine is attached.
scc.diag.job.missing.head: Stopped: an ingredient is missing
scc.diag.job.noaccess.fix: The machine has room, but item input is switched off on the side facing the Processing Calculator (side configuration of the machine, e.g. LTX Industries). Allow item input there, or put the calculator on a side that takes items.
scc.diag.job.noaccess.head: Waiting: the machine refuses items from this side
scc.diag.job.nocpu.fix: The AE2 network has no CPU free for this order, or none big enough. It starts by itself as soon as one is free; a Crafting Storage more makes it faster.
scc.diag.job.nocpu.head: Waiting: no free AE2 crafting CPU
scc.diag.job.nocrafter.fix: Place another Calculation Crafter - crafting steps share them, so a second one halves the wait.
scc.diag.job.nocrafter.head: Waiting: every Calculation Crafter is busy
scc.diag.job.nofuel.fix: The ingredients are in the furnace. Pick a fuel at its Processing Calculator (the empty slot next to 'Fuel') and keep some in the network - it is then topped up by itself.
scc.diag.job.nofuel.head: Stopped: a furnace has no fuel
scc.diag.job.nomachine.fix: Attach the machine this recipe needs and point a Processing Calculator at it.
scc.diag.job.nomachine.head: Stopped: no machine for this step
scc.diag.job.nomatch.fix: Cancel the order and place it again so it is planned against the recipes you have now.
scc.diag.job.nomatch.head: Stopped: the recipe no longer matches
scc.diag.job.notrader.fix: Put a villager with that trade into the trading block on the network.
scc.diag.job.notrader.head: Stopped: no villager offers this
scc.diag.job.novillager.head: Stopped: the trading block is empty
scc.diag.job.recipe.fix: The recipe existed when the order was planned and does not now - usually a mod or datapack changed. Cancel the order and place it again.
scc.diag.job.recipe.head: Stopped: the recipe is gone
scc.diag.job.redstonewait.fix: Its flow starts only with the redstone input it is set to. Give the Custom Processing Calculator a signal (or remove it), or change the redstone setting under Flow & targets.
scc.diag.job.redstonewait.head: Waiting: the recipe waits for a redstone signal
scc.diag.job.soldout.fix: Villagers restock twice a day at their workstation. It continues by itself.
scc.diag.job.soldout.head: Waiting: the offer is sold out
scc.diag.job.stalled.fix: The Calculation Crafter has the order but is not counting down. Check that its ingredients really arrive, then cancel and re-order.
scc.diag.job.stalled.head: Stopped: the crafter made no progress
scc.diag.job.storagefull.fix: Free some space or add storage. The order carries on by itself once there is room.
scc.diag.job.storagefull.head: Waiting: nowhere to put the result
scc.diag.job.traderspent.fix: A villager that has traded cannot be re-rolled. Use a fresh one.
scc.diag.job.traderspent.head: Stopped: this villager has already traded
scc.diag.nocrafter.fix: Place a Calculation Crafter on the network.
scc.diag.nocrafter.head: No Calculation Crafter
scc.diag.nocrafter.why: Machine recipes run, but anything that needs a crafting table cannot be built.
scc.diag.noinv.fix: Turn the calculator to a side the machine actually accepts, or check the machine's own side configuration.
scc.diag.noinv.head: %s calculators cannot reach their machine
scc.diag.noinv.why: The machine is set, but it offers no inventory on that side - so nothing can go in and nothing comes out.
scc.diag.nostorage.fix: Place a Storage Connector facing a chest, or one of the mod's own storage blocks, and connect it with cable.
scc.diag.nostorage.head: No storage on the network
scc.diag.nostorage.why: There is nowhere to put anything, so every order fails the moment it produces its first result.
scc.diag.noterminal.fix: Place a Terminal or a Crafting Terminal on the cable.
scc.diag.noterminal.head: No terminal on the network
scc.diag.noterminal.why: The network runs, but nobody can see into it or order from it - and the recipe book lives in a terminal, so autocrafting has nowhere to plan.
scc.diag.offline.fix: Put a Calculator Controller on the network and give it power, or switch power off entirely with /scc power off.
scc.diag.offline.head: The network is off
scc.diag.offline.why: Nothing runs while it is off - no order starts, no machine gets fed. Reason: %s
scc.diag.truncated.fix: Split it into two networks joined by a Wireless Transmitter, or remove cable you do not need.
scc.diag.truncated.head: The network is too large to read fully
scc.diag.truncated.why: The scan stopped at the block limit, so everything below is only part of the picture.
scc.diag.void.fix: If you did not mean it: turn off 'void excess' on this connector, or replace the container behind it.
scc.diag.void.head: A container has destroyed %s items
scc.diag.void.why: Something behind this connector throws away what it cannot hold. That is often deliberate - and when it is not, it is the most expensive mistake a storage network can make.
scc.gadget.gravity_gauntlet.tip1: Right-click: lift a mob, an item or a loose block (sand, gravel, dirt) - right-click again to throw it.
scc.gadget.gravity_gauntlet.tip2: Sneak + right-click: pull all items and XP within 10 blocks to you.
scc.gadget.gravity_gauntlet.tip3: 500 FE per lift, 1,000 FE per pull. Never players, bosses, other players' pets or blocks with an inventory.
scc.gadget.gravity_grenade.tip1: Throw it: for 3 seconds a tiny black hole pulls every mob within 5 blocks to where it lands.
scc.gadget.gravity_grenade.tip2: No damage, no block damage. Never pulls players, bosses or pets.
scc.gadget.little_star.tip1: Right-click a block: your Little Star appears and follows you.
scc.gadget.little_star.tip2: It glows, collects items within 6 blocks and hands them to you. It never fights and cannot be hurt.
scc.gadget.little_star.tip3: Right-click it: sit / follow. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: back into the item. Design Brush: paint it.
scc.gadget.mini_sun.tip1: Right-click a block: place it. Right-click into the air: throw it - it floats up where it lands.
scc.gadget.mini_sun.tip2: Light 15 all around, no monster spawns within 16 blocks, plants below grow about 50% faster.
scc.gadget.mini_sun.tip3: 10 FE/t while lit (250k FE buffer). Recharges from an SCC cable, other mods' cables or the Stellar Distributor.
scc.gadget.mini_sun.tip4: Right-click the sun: on/off. A redstone signal switches it off.
scc.gadget.orbit_formation.tip1: Anywhere in your inventory (or a Curios charm slot): its satellites orbit you and work.
scc.gadget.orbit_formation.tip2: Right-click: on/off. Add satellites at a Constellation Pedestal.
scc.gadget.orbit_formation.tip3: Power: its own charge first, then a worn Stellar Exo chestplate.
scc.gadget.planetarium.tip1: Right-click: control centre of your Stellar Gear - charge, tiers, effect switches, Orbit Formation and Little Stars.
scc.gadget.planetarium.tip2: Only the player who placed it can use it.
scc.gadget.planetarium.tip3: Sneak + right-click: sky projection on/off. A redstone signal switches it off.
scc.gadget.star_bubble.tip1: Empty - the Star Lasso puts a caught mob in here.
scc.gadget.star_lasso.tip1: Right-click a mob: catch it in an empty Star Bubble from your inventory.
scc.gadget.star_lasso.tip2: Passive and neutral mobs up to 100 health: 1,000 FE.
scc.gadget.star_lasso.tip3: Hostile mobs up to 40 health, and only at half health or less: 5,000 FE.
scc.gadget.star_lasso.tip4: Never players, bosses or other players' pets.
scc.gauntlet.no.block: Only loose blocks: sand, gravel, dirt and the like - nothing with an inventory
scc.gauntlet.no.claim: Not here - this area is protected
scc.gear.anvil.empty: Put Stellar Gear (drill, blade, bow or a Stellar Exo piece) in the top slot to switch its effects or upgrade it.
scc.gear.anvil.omni.drill: Omni Mining only fits the Stellar Drill
scc.gear.anvil.omni.has: This drill already has Omni Mining
scc.gear.anvil.resonance.max: This blade has reached the server limit.
scc.gear.anvil.resonance.tip: +1 attack damage per resonance, forever. The n-th costs n Chronon - from your inventory or the network the blade is linked to.
scc.gear.anvil.resonance.title: Chronon Resonance
scc.gear.anvil.slot.core.omni: Or the Omni Mining upgrade: installs into a Stellar Drill of any tier
scc.gear.anvil.slot.core.tip: The core of the next tier
scc.gear.anvil.slot.core.wings: Or an Elytra: installs Star Wings into a Singularity chestplate
scc.gear.anvil.slot.tool.tip: Stellar Drill, Stellar Blade, Stellar Bow or Stellar Exo
scc.gear.anvil.upgrade.tip: Uses the Star Core and raises the tool one tier. Enchantments, name, charge and settings stay.
scc.gear.effect.black_hole.desc: Mines a whole ore vein or tree at once (up to 64 blocks, 150 FE each). The drops gather where you hit.
scc.gear.effect.core_heat.desc: No freezing (with Exo boots you also walk on powder snow); fire and lava damage cut to a quarter. 40 FE per softened hit.
scc.gear.effect.dense_mirror.desc: Reflected arrows hit twice as hard.
scc.gear.effect.ember.desc: Autosmelt: ores become ingots, sand becomes glass. +25 FE per smelted block.
scc.gear.effect.ember_rim.desc: Mobs that hit the raised shield burn for 3 s. 100 FE.
scc.gear.effect.ember_shot.desc: Plasma arrows burn, and kills with the bow get Looting +1. 25 FE extra per shot.
scc.gear.effect.event_horizon.desc: Hostile projectiles within 5 blocks are swallowed (500 FE each); enemies close by are slowed slightly.
scc.gear.effect.flight.desc: Creative-style flight - only while all four Exo pieces are Singularity. 50 FE per tick while flying, from the chestplate. Mining in the air is as fast as on the ground.
scc.gear.effect.gravity.desc: A full hit pulls enemies around the target towards it and slams flying ones down. 4,000 FE, 6 s cooldown.
scc.gear.effect.gravity_arrow.desc: Where a fully drawn arrow hits, enemies within 5 blocks are pulled together and flying ones slammed down. Bosses are only slowed. 2,000 FE, 6 s cooldown.
scc.gear.effect.gravity_boots.desc: Stand on walls and ceilings: walk into a wall (2+ blocks high) and gravity, view and controls turn with you. Walk into the next surface to switch (wall, ceiling, back to the floor), jump pushes you off the surface, bump a ceiling while holding jump to flip onto it. Sneak or walk over an edge to drop back to normal gravity. No fall damage. 2 FE per tick on a wall or ceiling, 100 FE per caught fall.
scc.gear.effect.hammer.desc: Mines 3×3 around the block you hit. On a wall the area starts one block below that block and goes up from there, so aiming at head height keeps the floor level. Sneak to mine a single block. While you look at a block, every block that would go with it is outlined.
scc.gear.effect.homing_mirror.desc: Reflected projectiles fly back to whoever shot them (up to 48 blocks).
scc.gear.effect.network.desc: Drops go straight into SCC storage. Right-click an antenna or controller to bind; works within its wireless range. +25 FE per block.
scc.gear.effect.night_vision.desc: See in the dark - no flicker at the end, no particles, no icon. 1 FE/t, off at 0 FE.
scc.gear.effect.nova_flash.desc: Blocking makes hostile mobs in front of you (6 blocks) glow and slows them for 3 s. 1,000 FE, at most every 5 s.
scc.gear.effect.plasma_arc.desc: A full swing - even into thin air - throws a plasma sickle that cuts through up to 3 creatures, animals included. Tamed pets, named mobs and villagers are spared. 1,000 FE per throw.
scc.gear.effect.plasma_bolt.desc: A fully drawn shot becomes a fast plasma bolt that passes through up to 3 creatures (which ones: the Targets switch) - never players, pets, named mobs or villagers. 500 FE extra.
scc.gear.effect.plasma_cutter.desc: Hard blocks (obsidian, ancient debris, hard mod ores) break as fast as stone.
scc.gear.effect.plasma_push.desc: Blocked melee attackers are knocked back hard. 200 FE.
scc.gear.effect.plasma_shield.desc: 3 charges - each fully blocks one hit (melee, projectile, explosion). One charge back every 20 s for 2,000 FE. Not against /kill, the void, hunger, falling, fire or poison.
scc.gear.effect.red_harvest.desc: Looting +1, and every kill heals half a heart.
scc.gear.effect.seeking_star.desc: Fully drawn arrows lock on to a target up to 48 blocks ahead and chase it for the whole flight - flying mobs and the Ender Dragon too; if it dies, they pick a new one. Which targets: the Targets switch. Never players, pets, named mobs or villagers. 200 FE extra per shot.
scc.gear.effect.silk_fortune.desc: Silk Touch or Fortune III without enchanting - switch between them. The switch wins: Silk Touch pauses an enchanted Fortune, Fortune uses your enchanted level if it is higher than III.
scc.gear.effect.solar_skin.desc: In daylight under open sky the helmet charges your worn armor and held Stellar tools: 20 FE/t (Yellow Star) up to 40 FE/t (Singularity) in total. Works even when empty.
scc.gear.effect.solar_volley.desc: A fully drawn shot fires 3 arrows in a fan; the two side arrows hit for 60 %. 150 FE extra.
scc.gear.effect.star_mirror.desc: Blocked projectiles fly back where you look - arrows, fireballs, tridents, snowballs. 250 FE each.
scc.gear.effect.sun_flash.desc: Right-click: a flash blinds and slows enemies in front of you (8 blocks). 2,000 FE, 8 s cooldown.
scc.gear.effect.sunpower.desc: In daylight under open sky the drill mines twice as fast.
scc.gear.effect.time_stop.desc: Hold right-click for 1 s and release: enemies within 10 blocks freeze for 5 s. Costs 1 Chronon (inventory or bound network) and 20,000 FE, 60 s cooldown.
scc.gear.effect.wide.desc: The hammer grows to 5×5 (7×7 at Singularity) and digs 1 or 3 blocks deep.
scc.gear.msg.nochronon: Time Stop needs a Chronon (inventory or bound network)
scc.gear.msg.timestop: Time stopped: %s enemies frozen for %s s
scc.gear.msg.wings.none: The worn chestplate has no Star Wings
scc.gear.omni.name: Omni Mining
scc.gear.omni.tip: Install on the Star Anvil: the Stellar Drill mines every block with full drops, whatever mining level it needs
scc.gear.omni.tip2: Allthemodium, Vibranium, Unobtainium, Aurichalcum, Adamantite and the ores of other mods
scc.gear.omni.tip3: Unbreakable blocks (bedrock, barriers) and protected claims stay off-limits
scc.gear.tip.empty: Out of power - slow, effects off. Charge it at a Stellar Distributor.
scc.gear.tip.hull: Star Hull: absorbs %s%% of damage with FE (%s FE per point)
scc.gear.tip.omni: Omni Mining: installed - every ore, any mining level
scc.gear.tip.omni.how: Omni Mining: add the upgrade on the Star Anvil
scc.gear.tip.setbonus: Set bonus: all four pieces on Singularity = Flight
scc.gear.tip.use.blade: Right-click: Sun Flash · hold: Time Stop · Sneak + right-click: settings
scc.gear.tip.use.bow: Hold right-click: draw · with FE no arrows needed · Sneak + right-click: settings
scc.gear.tip.use.drill: Right-click: strip, scrape, path, douse · Sneak + right-click: settings · Right-click antenna/controller: bind
scc.gear.tip.use.exo: Sneak + right-click: settings · worn: key "Stellar Exo settings"
scc.gear.tip.use.shield: Hold right-click: block · switch effects at the Star Anvil or a Planetarium
scc.gear.tip.wings.how: Star Wings: add an Elytra on the Star Anvil
scc.gear.ui.bow.flight.tip:
Straight: all plasma arrows - centre arrow, Solar Volley side arrows and Plasma Bolt - fly without gravity.
Arc: they drop like normal arrows.
scc.gear.ui.bow.targets.tip:
What Seeking Star chases and what the Plasma Bolt passes through: Hostile, Passive (animals), All, or Off (no seeking; the bolt hits as before).
Never players, pets, named mobs, villagers or golems.
scc.gear.ui.click.next: Click: switch to the next setting.
scc.gear.ui.cost.charge: Charges %s FE/t in sunlight (shared between armor and held tools)
scc.gear.ui.cost.use: Power: %s FE each time it triggers
scc.gear.ui.depth.tip: Click: dig 1 or 3 blocks deep. Three deep mines up to three times as many blocks per swing - and uses that much more power.
scc.gear.ui.depth.title: Depth
scc.gear.ui.drops.tip: Click to switch between Silk Touch and Fortune III. Costs no extra power.
scc.gear.ui.exo_none: You are not wearing any Stellar Exo armor.
scc.gear.ui.live.tip: Measured over the last second: minus = this piece is using power, plus = it is charging (Solar Skin, charger, network).
scc.gear.ui.locked: Not unlocked yet - upgrade the tool in the Star Anvil.
scc.gear.ui.size.tip: Click: 3×3 → 5×5 → 7×7 (7×7 only at Singularity). Every block mined costs power, so a bigger area drains more per swing.
scc.gear.ui.tab.armor.tip: Worn Stellar Exo pieces - flight and the Star Wings settings are on the chestplate.
scc.gear.ui.tab.tools.tip: Stellar tools in your inventory and off hand - switch their effects without holding them.
scc.gear.ui.title: Stellar Gear
scc.gear.ui.toggle.tip: Click to switch this effect on or off. While off it does nothing and uses no power.
scc.gear.ui.unlink.tip: Removes the network binding: drops no longer go into SCC storage. Bind again by right-clicking an antenna or controller.
scc.gear.ui.wings.boost.tip:
Automatic thrust while gliding, like a rocket that never burns out.
Gentle 60 / Medium 120 / Strong 200 FE/t on top of gliding.
Sneak to pause the boost.
Without power: no boost - you keep gliding until you land, but cannot take off again.
scc.gear.ui.wings.mode.tip:
Creative: hover flight as before (50 FE/t).
Elytra: glide like an Elytra (10 FE/t, no durability) with automatic boost.
Only with all four Exo pieces on Singularity. Hotkey: "Star Wings: switch flight mode" in Controls.
scc.gear.wings.name: Star Wings
scc.gui.amount.math.tip: You can calculate here: 3*64+10, 64/4, (16-8)*2 - and use short forms: 12k, 1.5m
scc.gui.amount.wheel.tip.mb: Scroll: ±1 mB, Shift ±1,000 mB, Ctrl ±10,000 mB
scc.gui.antenna.hint: Insert a terminal or a gadget
scc.gui.antenna.link.tip: Bind the item in the slot to this network
scc.gui.antenna.title: Network Antenna
scc.gui.antenna.upgrade.remove: Sneak + right-click the antenna takes all upgrades out.
scc.gui.blueprint.empty: Nothing to order in this blueprint.
scc.gui.blueprint.folder.tip: Opens scc_blueprints in the game folder. Put .litematic, .nbt, .schem or material lists (.txt/.csv) there. SCC also looks in schematics/, config/litematica/ and the structures of this world.
scc.gui.blueprint.gadget.nomod: Building Gadgets 2 is not installed on the server.
scc.gui.blueprint.gadget.none: No Copy-Paste Gadget, Template or Redprint with a copy found.
scc.gui.blueprint.gadget.search: Looking for a Building Gadget copy...
scc.gui.blueprint.gadget.tip: Building Gadgets 2: reads the copy of a Copy-Paste Gadget, a Template or a Redprint - in your hand or your inventory.
scc.gui.blueprint.kind.list.tip: Material list as text (Litematica export, CSV or one item per line).
scc.gui.blueprint.kind.litematica.tip: Litematica schematic - read directly, Litematica itself is not needed.
scc.gui.blueprint.kind.structure.tip: Structure block file or Create schematic.
scc.gui.blueprint.nofiles: No blueprint files found. Click Folder and put a .litematic, .nbt or .schem file - or a material list - into scc_blueprints.
scc.gui.blueprint.note.cut: %s more materials do not fit (max. %s lines)
scc.gui.blueprint.note.fluids.tip: %s fluid blocks (water, lava) - fill them with buckets yourself.
scc.gui.blueprint.note.noitem.tip: Blocks that have no item (fire, portals, ...):
scc.gui.blueprint.note.title: Not on the list:
scc.gui.blueprint.note.unknown.tip: Unknown in this game (mod missing or typo):
scc.gui.blueprint.open.tip: Read the material list of a blueprint - Litematica, Create, structure block, WorldEdit, a Building Gadget or a pasted list - and see what the network is missing. Save it as an order list or order the missing items with one click.
scc.gui.blueprint.order.tip: Saves the list and orders right away: only what is missing in the network is crafted - the same plans as Order all in the order list.
scc.gui.blueprint.paste.name: Pasted list
scc.gui.blueprint.paste.tip: Reads a material list from the clipboard: a Litematica material list (table or CSV) or simple lines like "64 minecraft:stone", "Oak Planks x 32" or "glass, 16". Names may be IDs or item names.
scc.gui.blueprint.pick: Pick a file on the left, paste a list or read a Building Gadget. The preview shows what the blueprint needs, what the network has and what is missing.
scc.gui.blueprint.save.tip: Saves the blueprint as a new order list (top up, up to %s lines). It belongs to the network - every terminal sees it.
scc.gui.blueprint.title: Import Blueprint
scc.gui.breaking.keep.tip: On: stops with 1 durability left, so the tool never breaks. Repair or swap it to go on. Off: works until the tool breaks.
scc.gui.breaking.overdrive.base: On - normal speed for now, speeds up while Chronon is available
scc.gui.breaking.overdrive.starved: On - waiting for Chronon in the network
scc.gui.breaking.overdrive.tip: While there is Chronon in the network, the calculator speeds up one step every %s s, up to %s blocks per second. Each step costs more Chronon per second (%s). If the Chronon runs out, it falls back one step per second to its normal speed. Chronon is only used while it is actually breaking.
scc.gui.breaking.overdrive.title: Chronon Overdrive
scc.gui.breaking.state.noblock: That filter is not a block
scc.gui.breaking.state.noenergy: Tool out of power, extras off
scc.gui.breaking.title: Breaking Calculator
scc.gui.chart.forecast.tip: One harvester, open sky, no rain. Brighter bars: conjunction.
scc.gui.chart.lens.tip: The forecast is for this lens.
scc.gui.chart.map.tip: The whole sky seen from below: the middle is straight up, the rim is the horizon, north at the top.
scc.gui.chart.nosky: No sky objects here - they only stand in the Overworld sky and in space.
scc.gui.chart.title: Star Chart
scc.gui.chisel.speed: Speed: %s per second (faster with Job Accelerators)
scc.gui.chisel.state.idle: Ready - order a block from a chisel mod (Rechiseled, Chisel, Chipped) and it gets chiseled here.
scc.gui.chisel.state.nomod: No chisel mod installed (Rechiseled, Chisel or Chipped) - this block has nothing to do.
scc.gui.chisel.state.nopower: Not enough power in the network - chiseling is paused.
scc.gui.choice.any.tip: Splits the order across every accepted item in storage and starts it - each run uses one kind.
scc.gui.choice.auto.tip: Remove your fixed choice and let the calculator pick again.
scc.gui.choice.line: Other items fit here - click to choose (%s in storage)
scc.gui.choice.line.tip: The recipe accepts other items in this place. Pick one, or use all accepted items together.
scc.gui.choice.pick.tip: Use this one here - the order is planned again with it (same as the 4-squares button in the plan).
scc.gui.choice.saved: Choice saved - order again to use it.
scc.gui.choice.short: Not enough even with all accepted items: %s of %s
scc.gui.choice.title: Accepted here instead of %s
scc.gui.collector.every.tip: How often it looks. Twenty ticks is one second. Slower costs less and is plenty for anything that is not in a hurry.
scc.gui.collector.filter.tip: Empty means everything. Whitelist: only what is listed. Blacklist: everything except.
scc.gui.collector.range.tip: How far it reaches, in blocks. The area is a cube around the collector, so one more block in range is a lot more space - keep it as small as the job needs.
scc.gui.collector.show.tip: Draw the area in the world while this window is open
scc.gui.collector.title: Item Collector
scc.gui.compress.mode.1: On - everything up to the highest tier
scc.gui.compress.mode.2: On - keep 64 of each lower tier
scc.gui.compress.mode.3: On - keep 256 of each lower tier
scc.gui.compress.tip:
The network packs nuggets into ingots and ingots into blocks in the background - and every other 9 or 4 item recipe that can be crafted back (redstone, lapis, coal, mod metals ...). Saves slots and item types. Taking out, ordering and autocrafting split blocks again by themselves. Items reserved for running orders stay as they are. Exclude items with the item tag scc:no_compress.
Click: next setting.
scc.gui.connector.bucket.tip: Pick up a filled bucket with the cursor and click here - you keep the bucket
scc.gui.connector.bucket.title: Lock to held bucket
scc.gui.connector.clear.tip: Remove the lock - everything in the tank counts again
scc.gui.connector.clear.title: Unlock
scc.gui.connector.drain.tip: Move everything in this storage block into the rest of the network - what finds no room stays. The short way to swapping a storage block out without losing what is in it.
scc.gui.connector.filter.deny: Excluded: this slot removes what it matches from the list
scc.gui.connector.filter.deny.tip: Shift + left-click: switch this slot between allow and exclude
scc.gui.connector.filter.empty.tip: Click with an item on the cursor to filter on it, then scroll to switch to one of its tags. Fluids: drag one in from JEI or click with a filled bucket.
scc.gui.connector.filter.list.tip: Whitelist: only what is listed may go in, and it goes here before other storages with the same priority. Blacklist: everything except what is listed. The filter only affects what goes in - taking out is never filtered.
scc.gui.connector.filter.pattern.tip: Type a tag such as c:ores or a pattern such as *ingots* and press Enter. An item id works too.
scc.gui.connector.filter.scroll: Scroll: next tag of this item, back to the item at the end
scc.gui.connector.flow.tip: What the network may do here. Import only: the network takes from this storage but never fills it. Export only: the network fills it but never takes back - its contents stay out of the network entirely, so no order can plan with them.
scc.gui.connector.flow.title: Network access
scc.gui.connector.foreign.tip: Flux devices: connect a Flux Plug/Point directly to the Controller or an Energy Storage instead. A Storage Connector only uses batteries the network can draw power from.
scc.gui.connector.hide.tip: On: the filter also decides what the network sees and takes here, like an AE2 Storage Bus partition. Items the filter blocks stay in the container, but are neither shown in the terminal nor taken out. Off (default): the filter only decides what goes in; everything inside stays visible and can be taken out. Needs at least one filter slot set.
scc.gui.connector.lock.tip: Lock to whatever is in the tank right now
scc.gui.connector.lock.title: Lock to tank content
scc.gui.connector.nofilter: No filter here - only the direction and the Store/Take values above decide where it goes.
scc.gui.connector.priority.out.tip: Where the network takes things from first. Set this only if it should differ from the storing order - the classic case is “take from this chest, but never store in it”: store -10, take +10.
scc.gui.connector.priority.same.tip: Back to taking in the same order as storing
scc.gui.connector.priority.tip: Where the network puts things first. Higher is filled first; only what does not fit moves on to the next connector. Negative values work too.
scc.gui.connector.title: Storage Connector
scc.gui.connector.void.cycle: Click to switch: Off - Void excess (filter) - One slot per kind
scc.gui.connector.void.kind.tip: One slot per kind: every kind may fill at most one slot here (%s). Whatever a kind brings beyond that is deleted, so one kind can't fill the whole storage. A new kind with no free slot left is refused, never deleted. Works without a filter. Storages with a higher priority still get it first.
scc.gui.connector.void.tip: Whatever the filter lets in and no longer fits in here is deleted instead of clogging the network. For gravel, cobble and stone. The items on the whitelist come here before any storage without a matching whitelist, even one with a higher priority - so the overflow is deleted here instead of filling another storage. Needs a whitelist with at least one slot filled - without one the switch would delete everything the network has no room for, so it stays inactive. Works for fluids too: put the fluid into the whitelist.
scc.gui.constructor.every.tip: How long between two attempts. Twenty ticks is one second.
scc.gui.constructor.mode.tip: Place blocks: puts a block from the list into the space in front as soon as it is free. Drop items: throws the item out instead, for machines that want it lying on the ground.
scc.gui.constructor.mode.title: What it does
scc.gui.constructor.order.tip: In order: always the first entry that works. Round robin: every entry gets its turn. Random: rolls - for plantings that should not grow in stripes.
scc.gui.constructor.order.title: Which entry next
scc.gui.constructor.slot.tip: Click with an item on the cursor to set it, right-click to clear
scc.gui.constructor.title: Constructor
scc.gui.controller.asleep: Part of the network is not loaded (%s area(s))
scc.gui.controller.asleep.tip: The network continues into chunks that are not loaded right now - behind a Wireless Transmitter/Receiver (for example a Compact Machine nobody is standing in) or along a cable into an unloaded chunk. Machines and storage there are missing from upgrades, autocrafting and the item list until those chunks are loaded again. SCC never loads chunks by itself: keep the area loaded with a chunk loader. Not loaded:
scc.gui.controller.energy.feed: Power comes in through a cable or Flux Point on the Controller or an Energy Storage, or from batteries behind a Storage Connector.
scc.gui.controller.energy.nostorage: No Energy Storage in the network - add one to store more power
scc.gui.controller.idle: Resting - the controller at %s runs this network
scc.gui.controller.idle.tip: This network has a second Calculator Controller (at %s) - for example because a Wireless Receiver joined two networks into one. Only that controller pays for power, so the network is not billed twice; this one rests, its buffer helps out and its rules keep working. Remove one controller if you do not need it. To keep two networks apart, put a chest between them instead: a Transfer Calculator of one network fills it, a Storage Connector of the other reads it.
scc.gui.controller.nopowermode: Power is off - the network runs for free
scc.gui.controller.timeout.tip: How long waiting orders in this network may stand still before they give up on their own - for every order, also from Requesters, order lists and AE2. Never: the system never cancels an order by itself, only a player can; a real error (recipe impossible) pauses the order with its reason. What counts: a Processing Calculator's own choice > this network setting > each player's choice in F7 > server default. A server limit may cap it. Right-click: back.
scc.gui.controller.title: Calculator Controller
scc.gui.controller.upgrade.hint: %s blocks, %s upgrade stones to reach %s. Click to see what it needs and how many blocks the stones cover - nothing starts before you confirm.
scc.gui.controller.upgrade.none: Nothing in this network can be upgraded.
scc.gui.controller.upgrade.nothing: Nothing to do at this tier.
scc.gui.controller.upgrade.part.tip: This upgrade covers %s of %s blocks - the ones there are stones for. It ends when they reach %s; the rest keeps its tier.
The network found no way to craft %s with what is in storage. Stop the upgrade and click the tier again to see what is missing.
scc.gui.controller.upgrade.wait.noplanne: %s is missing and nobody can plan it: the network needs a terminal, and a player must be online.
The network is crafting %s for the upgrade. It continues as soon as the stones are in storage.
scc.gui.cradle.about.black_hole: Eats items and fluids from the network and turns them into power. 25 % more at new moon.
scc.gui.cradle.about.blue_giant: Huge, bright and short-lived. It ends in a supernova.
scc.gui.cradle.about.collapse: The pulsar collapses under the Dark Matter.
scc.gui.cradle.about.empty: Put in a seed. The cradle ignites it and holds the star in a magnetic cage.
scc.gui.cradle.about.igniting: The coils fire into one point - a star is being born.
scc.gui.cradle.about.pulsar: A spinning neutron star: power in bursts every two seconds, 25 % more at full moon. Energy Storage catches the bursts.
scc.gui.cradle.about.red_dwarf: Small and faint, but long-lived: a steady trickle for a basic network.
scc.gui.cradle.about.supernova: The star explodes. The coils try to hold it with a barrier charged from the network.
scc.gui.cradle.about.yellow_star: Like our sun. 25 % more power during the day. Sun Cores keep it burning longer.
scc.gui.cradle.diet.fluid: Its fluid is eaten: %s FE per 1,000 mB
scc.gui.cradle.diet.item: Eaten from the network: %s FE per item
scc.gui.cradle.diet.tip: Click with an item to add it, right-click to clear. The black hole eats these from the network: %s FE per item, at most %s FE/t. A bucket means its fluid.
scc.gui.cradle.feeding.tip: On: it eats its diet from the network. Off: it starves and evaporates after a while.
scc.gui.cradle.feeding.title: Feed the black hole
scc.gui.cradle.food.idle: Waiting - only active for a hungry black hole
scc.gui.cradle.food.stocked: Food in the network - eating it
scc.gui.cradle.food.tip: Black hole: when no item from the diet list is left in the network, the cradle orders the first one through autocrafting - up to a stack at a time, at most every 10 seconds, never while one is still being made. Fluids are not ordered.
scc.gui.cradle.hint.black_hole: Choose its diet below - it eats from the network.
scc.gui.cradle.hint.blue_giant: The coils will need %s FE from storage.
scc.gui.cradle.hint.empty: Seeds come from the Star Forge.
scc.gui.cradle.hint.igniting: The network pays the ignition charge.
scc.gui.cradle.hint.pulsar: Neutronium: +%s min spin. %s Dark Matter: collapse.
scc.gui.cradle.hint.red_dwarf: Afterwards the cradle is empty again.
scc.gui.cradle.hint.supernova: Held: %s Neutronium + a pulsar. Failed: the coils break.
scc.gui.cradle.hint.yellow_star: Each Sun Core in the matter slot adds %s min.
scc.gui.cradle.interference.tip: Stars pull on each other. All cradles in the same network or within 64 blocks are ranked by output: the strongest gives 100 %, the next 50 %, then 25 %, 12.5 % ... Two or three cradles pay off, twenty do not.
scc.gui.cradle.interference.title: Gravitational interference
scc.gui.cradle.keep.barrier: Storage too low for the barrier (%s FE)
scc.gui.cradle.keep.tip: When the star goes out, the cradle takes a new seed of this class from the network and ignites it - or orders one through autocrafting if there is none. It also refills Sun Cores for a Yellow Star and Neutronium for a Pulsar, one at a time, right when they are used. Dark Matter stays your call. Click: off, red, yellow, blue.
scc.gui.cradle.merged: Has absorbed %s black holes: +%s FE/t limit, eats more (up to %s black holes)
scc.gui.cradle.output.tip: Power goes into the network (Energy Storage, then the controller). What the network cannot take waits in the core for cables of other mods.
scc.gui.cradle.redstone.tip: The core gives a full signal while the star is about to die: the last 10 % of its life, during a supernova, or a starving black hole.
scc.gui.cradle.redstone.title: Redstone output
scc.gui.cradle.slot.matter.tip: Sun Core: longer life for a Yellow Star. Neutronium: spins a pulsar up. Dark Matter: collapses a pulsar. Neutronium: a Blue Giant ages 30 min per piece - an earlier supernova.
scc.gui.cradle.slot.seed.tip: Red Dwarf, Yellow Star or Blue Giant Seed. It is used up when the star ignites.
scc.gui.cradle.state.blocked: Blocked: two blocks above the core must be free
scc.gui.cradle.state.hungry: Starving - nothing on its diet in the network
scc.gui.cradle.state.incomplete: Incomplete: 8 frames around the core, 4 coils on the corners
scc.gui.cradle.state.nofilter: No diet set - it eats nothing and evaporates
scc.gui.cradle.state.nopower: Not enough power in the network for the charge
scc.gui.cradle.state.supernova: Charging the barrier - not enough yet!
scc.gui.cradle.title: Stellar Cradle
scc.gui.crafting_terminal.choose.tip: Several recipes use these ingredients. Click and pick what the grid should craft - the grid remembers it. Autocrafting is not affected.
scc.gui.crafting_terminal.clear.tip: Put the grid back into the network
scc.gui.crafting_terminal.layout.tip: Cycle how many storage rows are shown above the grid
scc.gui.crafting_terminal.reanalyse.tip: You blocked or unblocked a recipe. The recipe book still holds the old state; this rebuilds it. Blocking several recipes first and pressing once is the cheaper way.
scc.gui.crafting_terminal.stop.tip: Cancel all running jobs in the network
scc.gui.crafting_terminal.title: Crafting Terminal
scc.gui.craftmon.title: Crafting Monitor
scc.gui.creative.title: Creative Storage
scc.gui.custom.book.tip: Shared: every calculator with the Custom Pattern Module in front of the same kind of machine keeps the same recipes, and an order may use any of them. Own: this one keeps its own list, and only it runs these recipes - for machines with a template inside, like an Inscriber with its press.
scc.gui.custom.byproduct: Byproduct - collected, but not planned with
scc.gui.custom.clear.tip: Empty every field of this recipe. Save to delete it.
scc.gui.custom.empty: Empty - ingredients on the left, result on the right, or "+" in JEI or EMI
scc.gui.custom.flow.tip: Where each ingredient goes (the machine, a linked block, one into each empty linked block), in which wave, redstone start, result block, energy and more. Opens the flow editor with a map of the linked blocks.
scc.gui.custom.incomplete: Needs an output and an ingredient
scc.gui.custom.inpage: Ingredients page %s of %s - a recipe can have up to 18 ingredients
scc.gui.custom.jei.on: On - these and all JEI recipes
scc.gui.custom.jei.tip: Off: as soon as one recipe is set, this machine runs only the recipes here - orders use other machines or other ways for everything else (e.g. an Inscriber set up with one press). On: it also runs every JEI recipe of the machine in front of it.
scc.gui.custom.main: Main product - the network plans with this one
scc.gui.custom.middle: Shift + middle click: used up / stays in the machine
scc.gui.custom.page: Recipes, page %s of %s - click for the next page
scc.gui.custom.pick: Click with an item, drag one from JEI or EMI, or click to search
scc.gui.custom.pick.fluid: Click with a bucket or tank, drag a fluid or gas from JEI or EMI, or click to search (a gas goes into a free ingredient slot)
scc.gui.custom.pick.main: The main product: click with an item, drag one from JEI or EMI, or click to search
scc.gui.custom.reverse.tip: This recipe only: the ingredients go in last to first (the last filled field first, field 1 last). Saved with the recipe.
scc.gui.custom.save.tip: Save this recipe. Switching recipes or closing the window saves too.
scc.gui.custom.title: Custom Recipes
scc.gui.custom_processor.title: Custom Processing Calculator
scc.gui.destructor.filter.tip: Whitelist: breaks only the blocks in the list. Blacklist: breaks everything except them. An empty list breaks everything.
scc.gui.destructor.slot.tip: Click with a block on the cursor to set it, right-click to clear. Scroll to use one of its tags instead.
scc.gui.destructor.status.filtered: Block in front is not on the list
scc.gui.destructor.status.inventory: Block in front still holds items
scc.gui.destructor.status.own: Will not break its own network
scc.gui.destructor.status.unbreakable: Block in front cannot be broken
scc.gui.destructor.title: Destructor
scc.gui.destructor.tool.tip: Tool slot: breaks as if a player held this tool - Silk Touch and Fortune count, and it wears down. Empty: bare hand, so blocks that need a tool (stone, ores) are left alone.
scc.gui.distributor.batteries.tip: Also feed blocks that give power back out (capacitor banks, energy cubes). Off by default: a battery that feeds the network while the network feeds it only burns the transfer loss.
scc.gui.distributor.counts.limit: %s/%s blocks - tier limit, a higher tier supplies more
scc.gui.distributor.exclude.tip: Never supply this block - it stays out after every new search. Shift-right-click with the Network Tool does the same in the world.
scc.gui.distributor.include.tip: Take this block back into the area - it gets power again with the next search.
scc.gui.distributor.links.tip: Thin beams from the distributor to every block it supplies - gold for power, violet for Source. They show while this window is open; click to keep them.
scc.gui.distributor.list.empty: Nothing in range yet. Blocks that take FE show up here - and if one is left out, the reason.
scc.gui.distributor.list.emptylinked: No linked blocks yet. Shift-right-click this distributor with a Network Tool, then the blocks.
scc.gui.distributor.mode.area.tip: Supplies every block in range that takes FE. Batteries are left out unless you switch them on. Exclude single blocks with the x in the list.
scc.gui.distributor.mode.linked.tip: Supplies only the blocks you picked. Shift-right-click this distributor with a Network Tool, then shift-right-click blocks to add or remove them.
scc.gui.distributor.mode.title: Targets
scc.gui.distributor.refill.tip: With a Charging Module: also top up the tanks players carry (fluids, Mekanism chemicals). Turn it off if you use a tank as a bucket and want to empty it.
scc.gui.distributor.reserve.tip: Pause while the network holds less than this share of its capacity. The network itself keeps running. Click to step through off, 10, 25, 50 and 75 %.
scc.gui.distributor.show.tip: Draw the area in the world. It shows while this window is open; click to keep it after closing.
scc.gui.distributor.slot.0.tip: 16 blocks without an upgrade. Range Upgrades: 32 blocks each, up to 8. Infinite Range: the whole dimension. Dimensional: every dimension.
scc.gui.distributor.slot.1.tip: Power for the machines in range.
scc.gui.distributor.slot.2.tip: Source for the Ars Nouveau blocks in range - they draw the network's Source, however short their own reach is.
scc.gui.distributor.slot.3.tip: Charges the gear of permitted players in range.
scc.gui.distributor.st.1.tip: Takes nothing right now - asked again within a few ticks.
scc.gui.distributor.st.10.tip: You took this block out. It stays out after every new search until you click + to supply it again.
scc.gui.distributor.st.2.tip: Gives power back out like a capacitor bank, so it counts as a battery. Switch on Include batteries to feed it anyway.
scc.gui.distributor.st.3.tip: More blocks in range than this tier supplies. The nearest ones win - a higher tier from the Star Forge supplies more.
scc.gui.distributor.st.4.tip: Linked, but it takes no FE on any side.
scc.gui.distributor.st.5.tip: Linked, but its chunk is not loaded. The distributor never loads chunks.
scc.gui.distributor.st.6.tip: Linked, but outside the range. Add Range Upgrades or unlink it.
scc.gui.distributor.st.7.tip: An Ars Nouveau block - draws the network's Source through this distributor.
scc.gui.distributor.st.8.tip: Blocks of this mod are not supplied - they already belong to the network. Only the Mini Sun and the Energizing Socket are, because they often stand on their own.
scc.gui.distributor.st.9.tip: The entry point of another mod's energy network, such as a Flux Plug. Never supplied - the power would drain into that network or run in a circle.
scc.gui.distributor.title: Stellar Distributor

scc.gui.flow.tpl.undone: Template undone - the previous settings are back
