scc.station.anvil.broke: The anvil broke - a new one comes from storage
scc.station.anvil.nocombine: Waiting for two damaged %s to combine
scc.station.anvil.nodamaged: No %s is missing a quarter of its durability
scc.station.anvil.replaced: Placed a new anvil from storage
scc.station.anvil.waiting: Anvil broken - waiting for one in storage (ordered)
scc.station.error: Stopped after an error - see logs/scc.log
scc.station.nexp: Needs level %1$s: %2$s XP of liquid experience, the network has %3$s
scc.station.unsupported: This block has no menu the station can use
scc.substance.chemical: Chemical - ordered and counted in mB
scc.substance.fluid: Fluid - ordered and counted in mB
scc.sun.redstone: Mini Sun on, but a redstone signal holds it off - %s / %s FE
scc.tip.advanced_processing_calculator: Old block (before 1.4.0). Place it, or craft it on its own: it becomes a Processing Calculator of the same tier with the Routing and Supply Modules.
scc.tip.analysis: Manage the recipe analysis (one time, gets saved)
scc.tip.blue_giant_seed: Ignites a Blue Giant in the Stellar Cradle: 2,500 FE/t for 3 hours - then a supernova.
scc.tip.blue_plasma: Harvested from the Blue Giant. Forges things up to Blue Giant.
scc.tip.breaking_calculator: Breaks the blocks in front and puts the drops into the network.
scc.tip.cable: Links every device into one network.
scc.tip.calculation_crafter: Lets the network autocraft everything that needs a crafting grid.
scc.tip.calculator_controller: The heart of a network - and the only place power goes in.
scc.tip.calculator_monitor: Shows every calculator in the network with its state and load.
scc.tip.charging_module: In a Stellar Distributor: charges the gear of permitted players in its area and tops up their tanks (fluids and Mekanism chemicals, e.g. Jetpack hydrogen) - no wireless terminal needed. Only single items, never stacks.
scc.tip.chemical_storage: The same for Mekanism's chemicals - gases, slurries, infusion types and pigments. Each tier says how many different chemicals fit and how much of each; a new chemical takes the next free tank. Mekanism pipes can push into it and pull out of it directly.
scc.tip.chisel_calculator: Chisels blocks of the chisel mods (Rechiseled, Chisel, Chipped) for the network - no machine in front needed. Order a variant and it takes a base block of the same group (stone, planks ...) from storage and puts the variant back. Uses power like an Advanced Processing Calculator and chisels 16 pieces per second, faster with Job Accelerators.
scc.tip.chronon: Condensed time. Made by a feeding black hole in the Stellar Cradle - pays for Time Dilation.
scc.tip.confinement_coil: Stands on a frame corner of the Stellar Cradle. All four are needed to hold the star.
scc.tip.constructor: Places blocks from the network into the world - the counterpart to the Breaking Calculator. It looks in one direction and puts down whatever is in its list, as a block or as a dropped item. Redstone stops it. Its front faces you when placed - the Turn button in its window or a wrench points it elsewhere.
scc.tip.craftable: Only show items that have a recipe
scc.tip.crafting_monitor: A panel that lists every job the network is running, with its step and what it is waiting for. Right-click for the full report - the same one /scc doctor opens.
scc.tip.crafting_terminal: Terminal with a crafting grid - the ingredients come straight from the network.
scc.tip.create_clipboard: SCC: order everything on this list from a terminal - Order Lists, From Clipboard.
scc.tip.creative_storage: A storage that never runs out: whatever is listed in its filter is available without limit anywhere in the network. It only ever gives out - it accepts nothing, so it can never swallow your stock. Creative only, and deliberately not craftable.
scc.tip.custom_processing_calculator: Old block (before 1.4.0). Place it, or craft it on its own: it becomes a Processing Calculator of the same tier with all three modules - its recipes stay.
scc.tip.dark_matter: Harvested from the Singularity - more at new moon. Forges Singularity tier.
scc.tip.destructor: Breaks the block in front of it and puts the drops straight into the network - the counterpart to the Constructor. A tool in its slot counts like in your hand (Silk Touch, Fortune). Its list says which blocks may go; empty means all. Redstone stops it. The side with the glowing symbol faces you when placed - the Turn button in its window or a wrench points it elsewhere.
scc.tip.dimensional_upgrade: In an antenna or a wireless transmitter: no range limit, works across dimensions, +96 FE/t.
scc.tip.energizing_socket: Put the Energizing Orb from Powah on top and real Energizing Rods inside (up to 8). The socket charges the orb exactly like those rods would - same rate per rod tier, read from Powah's config. No rods, no charge. Power from an SCC cable or any FE cable. A Processing Calculator at the orb loads and unloads it as usual.
scc.tip.energy_storage: Holds FE for the network. Machines draw from it through the FE switch on a Processing Calculator, and a Transfer Calculator with FE on moves it in and out.
scc.tip.facade: Put it on a cable - or on a storage connector, collector, redstone emitter, antenna, monitor or wireless block - and it looks like that block. Craft it with any block you like, or blank, and stamp it with a block later.
scc.tip.facade.empty: No block set - craft it together with the block you want.
scc.tip.fe_module: In a Stellar Distributor: pushes FE from the network into every machine in its area, or only into linked blocks. Batteries and SCC blocks are left out.
scc.tip.fluid_storage: The same for fluids. Each tier says how many tanks it has and how much each holds; a new fluid takes the next free tank, and a full tank carries on in the next free one.
scc.tip.focus_pylon: Stands on a frame corner of the Star Forge. Every pylon adds a laser - and charges the forge faster.
scc.tip.harvester_mast: Two of these stacked on a Sky Harvester make its tower. The lens floats on top.
scc.tip.horizon_prism: Dark Matter held together by a Chronon. In the Star Forge, four raise a Neutron Star lens to a Singularity lens.
scc.tip.infinite_range_upgrade: In an antenna or a wireless transmitter: unlimited range within its own dimension, +40 FE/t.
scc.tip.interface: The network as an ordinary chest, for everything SCC does not know. Pipes, belts, hoppers and machines see nine slots: a slot without a template swallows whatever is put in and stores it, a slot with one is kept filled from storage so anything can help itself.
scc.tip.interface.whole: Next to a Create Schematicannon it shows the whole network: the cannon builds from all of storage.
scc.tip.inventory: Show what you already have and what is missing
scc.tip.item_collector: Vacuums items lying on the ground into the network. Range, interval and a filter are set in its window, and it can draw its area as a box in the world.
scc.tip.item_storage: Storage the network brings along - no container behind it. Counted in items the way Refined Storage does it, so a single sword does not cost a whole stack's worth of room. Priority, access mode and filter work exactly as on the Storage Connector.
scc.tip.job_accelerator: Makes every autocraft device on the network 25% faster - Calculation Crafters craft faster, Processing Calculators insert and collect without waiting. Up to 8 count (+200%, three times the speed). Uses 5 FE/t each and lights up while a job runs.
scc.tip.just_gooey_calculator: Lets the network autocraft Just Dire Things goo recipes.
scc.tip.just_transformation_calculator: Runs the fluid conversions from Just Dire Things itself: input fluid out of the tanks, catalyst item out of storage, result back into the tanks - no buckets involved. Right-click it and set one row per fluid with how much of it should be kept ready. It finds the way there on its own: ask for Time Fluid and it makes the Polymorphic Fluid underneath as part of the same step, so the in-between stages need no tank of their own.
scc.tip.lens_basic: Goes into a Sky Harvester. 2 Red Dwarf Ember upgrade it in the Star Forge.
scc.tip.lens_blue_giant: Goes into a Sky Harvester. 2 Pulsar Prisms upgrade it in the Star Forge.
scc.tip.lens_neutron_star: Goes into a Sky Harvester. 4 Event Horizon Prisms upgrade it in the Star Forge.
scc.tip.lens_red_dwarf: Goes into a Sky Harvester. A Solar Prism upgrades it in the Star Forge.
scc.tip.lens_singularity: Goes into a Sky Harvester. The highest lens.
scc.tip.lens_yellow_star: Goes into a Sky Harvester. A Plasma Prism upgrades it in the Star Forge.
scc.tip.logic_calculator: A node editor for your network: sources, logic and actions. Orders items on its own, forces your own recipe routes, blinks lamps, pauses machines and talks to other Logic Calculators by radio.
scc.tip.mode.base: Only the raw base resources - the shopping list.
scc.tip.mode.tree: All intermediate steps as an expandable tree plus build order.
scc.tip.network_antenna.ae2: Next to an AE2 network it offers what SCC can build, so AE2 jobs can use it.
scc.tip.network_tool: Right click any network block to see what it is attached to.
scc.tip.network_tool.bound: Picks blocks for the Stellar Distributor at %s - Linked: add them, Area: exclude them. Shift-right-click the air to stop.
scc.tip.network_tool.ports: Picks ports for the Processing Calculator at %s. Shift-right-click the air to stop.
scc.tip.neutronium: Harvested from the Neutron Star in pulses - more at full moon. Forges things up to Neutron Star.
scc.tip.pattern_module: Goes into a Processing Calculator: unlocks the recipe editor - your own recipes for machines JEI does not know, with fluid results and a shared recipe book.
scc.tip.plasma_prism: Blue Plasma bound with Dragon's Breath. In the Star Forge, one raises a Yellow Star lens to a Blue Giant lens.
scc.tip.portable_scanner: Right-click any block with an inventory or tank to see what is inside - sorted and searchable, like a terminal for just that block. Read only.
scc.tip.processing_calculator: Lets the network autocraft with the machine in front - feeds it and takes the result. Three module slots in its window add side configuration (Routing), fuel and power (Supply) and your own recipes (Custom Pattern). For Create, face the Basin or Depot: the Mixer or Press above counts as the machine. Facing into an Encased Fan's air stream, it does bulk washing, blasting, smoking or haunting.
scc.tip.protostar_shell: The empty shell of a star. Fill it in the Star Forge with 4 Red Dwarf Ember.
scc.tip.pulsar_prism: Neutronium tuned with an Echo Shard. In the Star Forge, two raise a Blue Giant lens to a Neutron Star lens.
scc.tip.quarry.power: %s FE/block · %s FE/t at full speed · %s card slots
scc.tip.quarry_card.fill: Fills every mined spot with cobblestone, cobbled deepslate, dirt or netherrack from storage - with Ores Only the landscape stays as it was.
scc.tip.quarry_card.fluids: Removes fluids in the area: source blocks are pumped into the network if it has room, otherwise removed. Water or lava running in from outside is sealed off with cobblestone from storage.
scc.tip.quarry_card.fortune: Mines with Fortune - the level grows with the tier (Basic I up to Singularity V). With Silk Touch in too, Silk Touch wins.
scc.tip.quarry_card.orbital: Endgame: the quarry digs no hole. It pulls the ores of its own dimension from orbit - mod ores too, about as common as the world generates them.
scc.tip.quarry_card.ores: Only mines ores (block tag c:ores) and leaves everything else standing.
scc.tip.quarry_card.silk: Mines with Silk Touch: ores come out as blocks.
scc.tip.quarry_card.void: Cobblestone, dirt, netherrack, deepslate and the like vanish instead of filling storage (item tag scc:quarry_void).
scc.tip.quarry_marker: Retired - the Quarry Survey Tool replaces it. Break it to get one.
scc.tip.range.distributor: In a Stellar Distributor: widens the area it supplies.
scc.tip.range_upgrade: In an antenna or a wireless transmitter: +32 blocks of range, +4 FE/t.
scc.tip.receiver.unlinked: Not bound - right click a Wireless Transmitter.
scc.tip.reconstructor_calculator: Runs the Atomic Reconstructor from Actually Additions for the network. Face it at the reconstructor (any side except the one the beam comes out of) or into the beam. It lays the ingredients into the beam and collects the results. The lens decides the recipes: no lens or the plain Lens for the reconstructor recipes, the Lens of Color for the color changes. The reconstructor still needs its own power.
scc.tip.red_dwarf_ember: Harvested from the Red Dwarf. Forges things up to Red Dwarf.
scc.tip.red_dwarf_seed: Ignites a Red Dwarf in the Stellar Cradle: 80 FE/t for a whole day.
scc.tip.redstone_emitter: Sends a redstone signal once the stock passes the amount you set.
scc.tip.requester: Keeps the items you set in stock and re-orders them on its own.
scc.tip.restock.off: Shift + right click: keep items, fluids and power topped up in your inventory
scc.tip.restock.on: Restocking: %s - shift + right click to change
scc.tip.routing_module: Goes into a Processing Calculator: side configuration for items, fluids and chemicals (input, output, fuel per side, Auto) and ports on other blocks with the Network Tool.
scc.tip.security_terminal: Hands out the rights of the network - who may take, put, order and build. Only the owner can open it.
scc.tip.settings_card: Copies the settings of one SCC block onto another of the same kind - with its upgrades: they come from storage or your inventory, missing ones are ordered.
scc.tip.sky_harvester: Put two Harvester Masts on top and a lens inside. Its beams pull matter down from the objects in the sky, straight into the network.
scc.tip.sky_harvester.photons: Photon mode: collects starlight as power instead - needs no power itself.
scc.tip.solar_prism: Sun Cores bound with blaze fire. In the Star Forge, one raises a Red Dwarf lens to a Yellow Star lens.
scc.tip.soul_storage: Stores souls from Industrial Foregoing Souls. Fill it with a Storage Connector or Transfer Calculator on top of a Soul Laser Base, or let Soul Pipes deliver to an SCC Interface set to Accept. Soul Pipes and Soul Surges get the network's souls from an SCC Interface.
scc.tip.source_module: In a Stellar Distributor: Ars Nouveau blocks in its area draw the network's Source, however short their own reach is.
scc.tip.source_storage: Stores Source from Ars Nouveau. To Ars it looks like a Source Jar - but behind it stands the Source of the whole network: every Source Storage and every Source Jar a Storage Connector faces. Relays fill it, machines nearby drink from it.
scc.tip.star_chart: Right-click: what stands high now and next, the moon, the next conjunction and a photon forecast.
scc.tip.star_forge: The core of the Star Forge. Surround it with eight frames and put Focus Pylons on the corners above. Raises blocks, stones and lenses one tier at a time. Connected by cable, it takes orders from the network by itself.
scc.tip.star_forge_frame: Eight of these around a Star Forge core make the forge. Cables connect to any frame of a formed forge or cradle.
scc.tip.star_quarry: Mines a whole area layer by layer - a small star hovers over the pit and cuts with lasers. Set width, length, depth and position in its window or stake the area out with Quarry Markers. Drops go into the network, otherwise into a chest next to it or its own buffer. Cards add Void, Silk Touch, Fortune, Ores Only, Fluids, Fill Holes and Orbital Mining.
scc.tip.stellar_cradle: Holds a star in a magnetic cage and turns its whole life into power. Eight Star Forge Frames around it, four Confinement Coils on the corners above.
scc.tip.stellar_distributor: Hands the network's power, Source and charge to everything around it - no cables. Put modules in: FE for machines, Source for Ars blocks, Charging for players.
scc.tip.storage_connector: Puts the chest or tank in front into the network.
scc.tip.storage_monitor: A panel that shows the stock of one item, and works like a drawer. Left-click: take a stack out. Right-click with an empty hand: take a single item. Right-click with something in hand: put it into the network - sneak to add everything of that kind from your inventory. An empty panel takes its item from the first thing you put in; sneak + right-click with an empty hand clears it. Right-click with a battery and it shows the network's power instead, with a live FE/t balance. To break it, sneak and then hit it. Sits on a cable like every other panel.
scc.tip.sun_core: Harvested from the Yellow Star - faster by day. Forges things up to Yellow Star.
scc.tip.supply_module: Goes into a Processing Calculator: keeps the machine supplied on its own - a fuel item topped up (ordered when it runs out), liquid fuel, FE into the machine, a Blaze Burner kept lit.
scc.tip.survey.link: Shift + right-click a Star Quarry: link it and see how far it reaches.
scc.tip.survey.max: Up to %s×%s with the survey bonus (tier: %s), %s layers deep
scc.tip.survey.none: Not linked - Shift + right-click a Star Quarry.
scc.tip.survey.pointa: Point A at %s %s %s - now mark the opposite corner.
scc.tip.survey.points: Shift + right-click two blocks: the corners of the area (top = the higher one, as deep as the tier allows).
scc.tip.survey.reset: Shift + right-click the air: clear the points.
scc.tip.survey.slot: Put it into the quarry's survey slot to apply the area - while it sits there the area may be bigger (survey bonus).
scc.tip.survey.window: Right-click: fine-tune offset and size in a window.
scc.tip.terminal: See and take out the network stock, and order anything it can build.
scc.tip.toggle_bus: A piece of cable that opens on a redstone signal. Everything behind it becomes a separate network until the signal goes away - the way to switch an outpost off without taking cable apart.
scc.tip.transfer_calculator: Moves items and fluids between the network and the block in front. Exporting fuel into a Create Blaze Burner keeps it lit.
scc.tip.upgrade: Right-click an SCC block of tier %s to raise it to %s.
scc.tip.upgrade.breaking: Right-click a Breaking Calculator of tier %s to raise it to %s.
scc.tip.upgrade.keeps: Keeps all settings, filters and patterns. One-time use.
scc.tip.wall_advanced_processing_calcula: Old panel (before 1.4.0). Place it, or craft it on its own: it becomes a Processing Calculator Panel with the Routing and Supply Modules.
scc.tip.wall_crafting_terminal: The crafting terminal as a small panel on the cable. Same window, same shared grid - right-click a cable's side with it.
scc.tip.wall_custom_processing_calculato: Old panel (before 1.4.0). Place it, or craft it on its own: it becomes a Processing Calculator Panel with all three modules - its recipes stay.
scc.tip.wall_processing_calculator: The processing calculator as a small panel that sits on the cable itself: right-click the side of a cable with it and it moves in, keeping every connection. The panel goes against the machine, so the cable runs behind it instead of taking a block of its own - and it works on top and bottom too, for a machine above or below.
scc.tip.wall_redstone_emitter: The redstone emitter as a small panel on the cable - several of them fit on one cable block. Same settings; the signal goes out in every direction.
scc.tip.wall_terminal: The terminal as a small panel that sits on the cable itself: right-click a cable's side with it and it goes in, cable and all. Twelve pixels across, so a facade leaves a rim around it.
scc.tip.wall_transfer_calculator: The transfer calculator as a small panel that sits on the cable itself: right-click the side of a cable with it and it moves in, keeping every connection. Same filters and same directions as the full block - it just no longer needs a block of its own, so a cable can run along a wall of chests and serve each one.
scc.tip.wireless.unlinked: Not linked - right click a Network Antenna.
scc.tip.wireless_crafting_terminal: Like the wireless terminal, but with a crafting grid.
scc.tip.wireless_receiver: Continues the network wherever you place it. Both ends must stay chunk-loaded.
scc.tip.wireless_terminal: Terminal from afar. Right-click a Network Antenna to link it.
scc.tip.wireless_transmitter: Sends the network by radio. Right-click it with a Wireless Receiver to bind that receiver.
scc.tip.wormhole_gate: Teleports you to any other Wormhole Gate on the same network. Right-click for the list of gates; every jump costs FE.
scc.tip.wormhole_remote: A Wormhole Gate for your pocket. Right-click a Network Antenna or Wormhole Gate to link it, then right-click into the air: pick a gate and a rift opens in front of you - walk in.
scc.tip.wormhole_remote.unlinked: Not linked - right-click a Network Antenna or Wormhole Gate.
scc.tip.wrench: Right click: turn a block. Shift + right click: take it down - facade first, then the device on the cable, then the cable itself.
scc.tip.yellow_star_seed: Ignites a Yellow Star in the Stellar Cradle: 500 FE/t for 10 hours.
scc.tooltip.card.empty: Empty - sneak + right-click a block to copy its settings
scc.tooltip.card.help: Right-click a block of the same kind to apply
scc.tooltip.failed: Tooltip unavailable: the item's own mod failed to build it (see logs/scc.log)
scc.tooltip.network_conduit: Carries an SCC network through Ender IO conduit bundles, just like a Network Cable
scc.tooltip.options: %s options for this ingredient - middle-click to switch
scc.help.setting.cradleHoleMerges: Stellar Cradle: how many other black holes one black hole may absorb (0 = they never merge). Each one raises its limit by cradleHoleMergeBonus.
scc.help.setting.cradleHoleMergeBonus: Stellar Cradle: FE/t more limit for each absorbed black hole (10,000 = 10 more items eaten per second).
scc.guide.integrations.l.draconic: Draconic Evolution - a Processing Calculator in front of a Fusion Crafting Core runs fusion recipes: catalyst into the core, ingredients into the injectors.
scc.guide.integrations.l.create: Create - Mechanical Crafters, Sequenced Assembly, basin with Mixer or Press and Blaze Burner, and bulk washing, smelting, smoking and haunting in the air stream of an Encased Fan all run from a Processing Calculator. The Schematicannon's material list (clipboard or book) becomes an Order List.
scc.guide.integrations.l.chisel: Chisel, Chipped and Rechiseled - their block groups become recipes of the Chisel Calculator.
scc.guide.integrations.l.aa: Actually Additions - the Atomic Reconstructor is the station of the Reconstructor Calculator.
scc.guide.integrations.l.blueprints: Building plans - vanilla structure files, Create schematics, Litematica and WorldEdit files and Building Gadgets 2 copies are read as an Order List of their materials.
scc.guide.integrations.l.cm: Custom Machinery - a Processing Calculator at a machine the modpack made itself offers only that machine's recipes.
scc.guide.integrations.l.mmr: Modular Machinery Reborn - a Processing Calculator at the controller reads which machine is built there and offers only its recipes: ingredients into the input buses, results out of the output buses.
scc.guide.integrations.l.domum: Domum Ornamentum - the Architect's Cutter in front of a Processing Calculator; it has no inventory, the calculator brings its own.
scc.guide.integrations.l.extended: Extended Crafting - the Basic to Ultimate tables (3x3 to 9x9), by hand and as Auto Table, are filled by a Processing Calculator.
scc.guide.integrations.l.ftbic: FTB Industrial Contraptions - when a job switches recipe, the calculator takes the old seed or helper out of the input slot.
scc.guide.integrations.l.ftbteams: FTB Teams - the Security Terminal can give rights to a whole team; joining or leaving counts at once.
scc.guide.integrations.l.if: Industrial Foregoing - the Potion Brewer works as a machine of the Custom Processing Calculator.
scc.guide.integrations.l.ironfurnaces: Iron Furnaces - every furnace of the mod counts as a smelting station, also the ones its recipe-viewer plugin forgets (Allthemodium, Vibranium, Unobtainium).
scc.guide.integrations.l.kubejs: KubeJS - Star Forge recipes with event.recipes.scc.star_forging(...) and server events under SCCEvents.
scc.guide.integrations.l.ltx: LTX Industries - a job checks the machine's recipe mode and says which mode it needs; recipes made only of fluids are seen as running.
scc.guide.integrations.l.magic: Magic mods (Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells and others) - the Magic Ward Satellite only exists when one of them is installed.
scc.guide.integrations.l.mysticalag: Mystical Agriculture - the Soul Extractor gets as many soul items as a full Soul Jar needs.
scc.guide.integrations.l.mysticalauto: Mystical Automation - Infusion and Awakening Altarnator are filled correctly.
scc.guide.integrations.l.neovitae: Neo Vitae - Blood Altar and Alchemy Table: a job waits while they pay with blood instead of counting them as stuck.
scc.guide.integrations.l.occultism: Occultism - rituals: the trigger goes into the golden bowl, the ingredients into the sacrificial bowls around it, and the result is picked up where Occultism puts it.
scc.guide.integrations.l.oritech: Oritech - machines with an input and an output tank: only the output tank is drained.
scc.guide.integrations.l.polymorph: Polymorph - pick between conflicting recipes at the crafting grid of the SCC terminals.
scc.guide.integrations.l.apotheosis: Apotheosis - the affix rarity works as a filter tag in the Transfer Calculator.
scc.guide.integrations.l.client: Mouse Tweaks, shader packs (Iris/Oculus) and dynamic lights - the mouse wheel over inventory slots stays Mouse Tweaks' job, sky effects hold back under shaders (F7 turns them back on), and the Little Star shines as a moving light.
scc.guide.integrations.l.addons: Hephaestus and other mods through the SCC add-ons (Calculated Foundry, Farming, Defense, Mobs, Machinery) - each add-on has its own pages in this guide.
scc.tip.matter_link: Connects the SCC network with a Replication network (matter pipes). For Replication it is a matter tank whose content lies in SCC's fluid storages, it powers the Replication network from SCC, and with a Processing Calculator in front it replicates everything the Replication network has a finished pattern for - the recipe uses the matter as fluids. Right-click: status.
scc.replication.no_network: Not connected to a Replication network - place it next to a matter pipe.
scc.replication.power: Replication network power: %s / %s FE (given from SCC so far: %s FE)
scc.replication.jobs: Replications queued: %s, done: %s, waiting for matter: %s
scc.guide.integrations.l.replication: Replication - Matter Link: SCC stores the matter as fluids, powers the Replication network and replicates every item with a finished pattern on order (Processing Calculator in front of the link).
scc.msg.wireless.permission: Only the antenna owner can configure or use this wireless link.
